description: Header file defining the LocalStore class for database operations within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It declares methods for managing a local SQLite database, including opening connections, creating tables, managing limits, and handling entries.

classes.name: LocalStore
classes.description: A class that manages local database connections and operations such as creating tables, adding/removing entries, and retrieving data within the plugin environment.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens a connection to the database at the specified path.

methods.name: CreateTable
methods.description: Creates a new table in the database.

methods.name: SetLimit
methods.description: Sets a limit on the number of entries in a specified table.

methods.name: GetEntriesCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of entries within a specified range in a table.

methods.name: GetEntries
methods.description: Retrieves entries from a table starting at a specific index.

methods.name: RemoveEntries
methods.description: Removes entries within a specified range from a table.

methods.name: AddEntry
methods.description: Adds a new entry to a specified table.

methods.name: buildGetEventsQuery
methods.description: Builds an SQL query string to retrieve events from a table.
